decision: Accept original n_o 180 -> 137 only: primary NIVEL postprint title/authors/DOI 10.1093/her/cyl160 match the assigned work (journal header 2008 versus coded 2007 retained). The named proactive-coping group-by-time analysis explicitly includes only goal reporters at T1 and T2, with 64 intervention and 73 mutually exclusive controls. Methods and Results repeat that restriction; protected sibling scope names the same outcome and model. N=180 is the broader questionnaire-completer sample, used for other outcomes such as self-efficacy. This is a participant count, not sessions or repeated observations. The printed denominator df=136 is preserved without repairing it or deriving N from df; explicit target-group counts establish 137. Appended table bodies are absent in this text, so no table-only or absence claims are made. All ES/p, replication and author-verdict fields remain frozen.
